ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-31-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change of a minor.

Dept. 514, Judge: Paul H. Alvarado, Clerk: S.Vantree, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840

Petitioner Jieyun Zhou mother of minors present.
Baoyu Huang sworn as Cantonese interpreter for petitioner.
Petitioner sworn and examined.

Proof of Publication on file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minors from Ziyan Zhang to Joe Ziyan Zhang and Junyan Zhang to John Junyan Zhang.

Decree Changing Name signed in open court.
